canonical_definition: ARC-challenge (AI2 Reasoning Challenge) is a multiple-choice question-answering benchmark focused on grade-school science and commonsense reasoning tasks. It specifically emphasizes challenging subsets of the dataset (e.g., "hard split" or "difficult split" questions) that require advanced reasoning capabilities, as opposed to easier variants like ARC-easy. The instrument is commonly used to evaluate models' performance on complex science and reasoning problems through accuracy metrics, though some variants incorporate exact match evaluation or normalized scoring. Multiple papers associate it with assessing in-context learning, robustness, and fine-tuning effectiveness in large language models.
